title: OttoDAO
tagline: OttoDAO builds capital formation mechanisms for public goods!
description: OttoDAO builds capital formation mechanisms for public goods! Work in progress, as we didn't manage to find time to come to the hackathon until late on Saturday. Sorry! However, the time was spent wisely for something that is hopefully impactful for the Ethereum ecosystem: LottoPGF.org!
how_its_made: We didn't manage to build anything, but we have a figma prototype. We're developing a lottery to fund public goods with verifiable randomness and efficient shuffling algorithms. We've deployed on and there are already people hacking on our contracts. We also built a VRF you can deploy on any EVM chain.
